movie_title: C-SPAN Cities Tour - Albany: Lily of the Mohawks
introduction: Author Jack Casey tells the story of Kateri Tekakwitha, a Mohawk woman born in present-day New York

vocabulary.definition: to make (a word, name, or phrase) more English in form or character; to adapt to English usage.

vocabulary.definition: the action of intervening on behalf of another.
